structures: "Are Layoffs Even Worth It?": Severance and the cost question → What layoffs save → Natural attrition and hiring freezes → Other alternatives: bonuses, early retirement → Who really wants layoffs → Christopher Hohn and TCI

"Food Delivery - The $432B Industry That Benefits No One": Delivery apps are a scam → The cost to consumers → Hidden menu markups → Delivery drivers' real pay → Restaurants squeezed by fees → The apps lose money too → Logistical nightmare conclusion

"How Generosity Became A Burden - The American Tipping Crisis": The tipping burden today → How tipping reached America → After the Civil War: tips replace wages → Bans, minimum wage exclusions and the $2.13 wage → Why workers and public accept tipping → Psychology and iPad terminals → Anti-tipping movement

"People Love Mocking The Metaverse. Mark Is Getting The Last Laugh.": Cold open: Zuckerberg gives up the metaverse → Oculus and why Facebook bet on VR → Quest 2 and the headset nobody used → Pulling back: layoffs and AI → Past pivots: drones and satellites → Zuckerberg's next swings

"The Man Who Nearly Bought Netflix Is Now Wanted For Running A Ponzi": Cold open: Icahn, Netflix and the Ponzi accusation → Icahn's background and arbitrage → Corporate raiding in the 70s and 80s: Tappan, Saxon → TWA takeover and collapse → T. Boone Pickens, Gulf Oil and mega takeovers → Companies fight back: poison pill, golden parachutes, white knights → Why corporate raiding died → Hindenburg accusation and wrap-up

"This Guy Stole $120M From Google & Meta": Summary of the heist and its end → From Lithuanian car theft to a new plan → Finding the payroll weak point → Posing as Quanta Computer → Tens of millions wired to random accounts → Spreading the money and staying in Lithuania → FBI arrest and sentence → Aftermath and companies' indifference → Lessons and reflection

"TikTokers Are Getting A Harsh Reality Check": Pay gap and creator exodus → Advertisers won't come → Short-form is harder to monetize → YouTube and Instagram face it too → What TikTok can do → Silver lining: ByteDance and the CCP

"YouTube Should Feel Stupid For Banning AdBlock": Claim and counterargument → Reputation: backlash and Netflix → Bans don't work: prohibition and workarounds → Competition risk → The alternative: Google's own playbook → The right strategy and slippery slope
